The code builds. 
It deploys.
I have installed it on an Android device.
the stream of consciousness demo repo 
is at https://github.com/kfedora/my-stream-of-consciousness
there is no readme there though because it is a new repo 
not sure what the meta is for these kind of things
file names and commit messages in present tense are good 
https://github.com/kfedora/my-stream-of-consciousness/tree/main/entries/2026/10/18
and the fact that they are tucked in a folder is exactly what I wanted so that is good

we should use the best practices 
and avoid deprecated APIs or packages when there is a better option available
